previous_statement: Entrywise amplification gives h_{2n}(Z)=(h_n(Z_ij)); contractive target corner compression yields ||h_{2n}(Z)||>=max_ij||h_n(Z_ij)||>=a_n max_ij||Z_ij||. Combining with the preceding bound gives ||h_{2n}(Z)||>=a_n||Z||/2, and taking the infimum gives a_{2n}>=a_n/2.
new_statement: Even granting the entrywise amplification identity h_{2n}(Z)=(h_n(Z_ij)), the permitted definitions and upstream lemmas supply neither contractive target-corner compression nor the domain block-norm estimate ||Z||<=2 max_ij||Z_ij||. Without the latter, the displayed entrywise lower bounds yield at most ||h_{2n}(Z)||>=a_n max_ij||Z_ij|| and do not imply ||h_{2n}(Z)||>=a_n||Z||/2 or a_{2n}>=a_n/2. Thus the original conclusion is withdrawn, and node 1.3.1 (hence this dyadic propagation route) remains unsupported by the allowed inputs.
